title: Little Boy in Coat by Shrub, 1954 Outdoor B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-century black-and-white snapshot depicting a young boy posing proudly outside in front of a neatly sculpted, spherical hedge. The child is dressed smartly in a tailored light-colored double-breasted overcoat, a matching cap, folded striped socks, and dress shoes. The backdrop reveals a suburban backyard featuring a paved path and chain-link fence under bright daylight. The physical print features decorative scalloped deckle edges.
